name: default_global
toml:
schema_version = 2

[server]
host = "127.0.0.1"
port = 8765
allow_non_loopback = false
lan = true
lan_networks = []

[llm]
auto_classify = true
auto_embed = true

[llm.providers.ollama]
type = "ollama"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:11434"
timeout_seconds = 120.0
max_retries = 2
backoff_seconds = 1.0

[llm.providers.heuristic]
type = "heuristic"

[llm.classification]
provider = "ollama"
model = "qwen2.5:7b-instruct"

[llm.embeddings]
provider = "ollama"
model = "nomic-embed-text"

[llm.summarization]
provider = "ollama"
model = "qwen2.5:7b-instruct"

[agents.claude_code]
type = "claude_code"
executable = "claude"
permission_mode = "acceptEdits"
allowed_tools = []
timeout_seconds = 3600.0
extra_args = []

[execution]
enabled = false
default_agent = "claude_code"
max_concurrent_runs = 2
max_attempts_per_task = 3
auto_schedule = false
isolation = "worktree"
allow_push = false
allow_merge = false

[jobs]
worker_concurrency = 4
gpu_concurrency = 1
per_agent_concurrency = 2
per_repository_concurrency = 1
verify_concurrency = 1
lease_seconds = 60
default_max_attempts = 5

[stacks]
auto_accept = true

[verification]
auto_accept = true

[retention]
telemetry_payload_days = 30
run_log_days = 90

[claude]
capture_tool_payloads = false
max_payload_chars = 4000

[automation]
max_depth = 3

[trackers]

name: scalars_and_escapes
toml:
s = "quote \" backslash \\ tab 	 newline \n unicode é 漢 emoji 🙂 ctrl \u0001"
f = 1.5
big = 1e+20
small = 1e-07
whole = 120.0
b = true
i = -3
empty_list = []
list = [
    "a",
    "b",
]

[empty_table]

[nested.x.y]
z = 1

["dotted key"]
"needs quote" = 1
bare_key = 2

value.s:
quote " backslash \ tab 	 newline 
 unicode é 漢 emoji 🙂 ctrl 

name: provider_and_tracker_tables
toml:
[llm.providers.lab]
type = "openai_compatible"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1"
timeout_seconds = 120.0

[llm.providers.ollama]
type = "ollama"
max_retries = 0

[trackers.acme]
type = "jira"
projects = [
    "ACME",
]
cancelled_resolutions = [
    "Won't Do",
    "Duplicate",
]
pr_fields = []
